title: Prompt ablation (resume): does a goal+schema system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion for M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN under the same credential-free CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058?
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (identical minimal task, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds, model artifacts, scorer and configuration), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt - condition P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, derived from the grandparent harness SYS prompt (research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py, file sha256 4e2b6710c78f4e4399a8ed5ae78e0231563fb832b780b80a955bcbc16b046862; SYS string sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with the single ref->selector schema alignment (adapted string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716) - convert M-7B-QWEN's or M-3B-QWEN's step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion, where the ONLY varied dimension between treatment and comparator cells is prompts.system?
hypothesis: H1 (capability): at least one of M-7B-QWEN (evaluated first) or M-3B-QWEN clears the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, converting the parent FALSIFIES (bounded by audit VF-01 to the underspecified-prompt ceiling) into SUPPORTS at the goal/schema protocol ceiling. H1b (attribution): for each clearing candidate the contemporaneous within-experiment paired comparator cell under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent system prompt) fails the bar in the same run, isolating the goal/schema prompt as the driver (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED) rather than a run-level environment artifact.
falsifier: H0: no measurable treatment cell clears the bar (every COMPLETE M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN treatment cell has task_success_rate < 0.6), i.e. the goal/schema prompt does not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion and the audited VF-01 failure mode (step-0 reveal click, re-click loop, zero answer actions) recurs under the enriched prompt. This is the Director's bounded negative: no factory-provisionable credential-free local CPU-quantized endpoint in the tested 3B-8B Qwen class can complete the minimal multi-step Web-agent task even with a properly specified goal/schema, so readiness condition (3) of the gated four-arm benchmark is not satisfied by this model class and the benchmark must be re-directed to hosted endpoints or a different model class. FALSIFIES is asserted only over the COMPLETE, comparator-valid evaluated candidate set; a candidate whose treatment PC-JSON gate failed is recorded as UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED / unresolved, not counted as a capability failure (decision_rule rules 2a/2b). A comparator cell that CLEARS the bar or drops below parseable 0.6 makes the prompt effect non-identifiable and the packet MEASUREMENT_INVALID (rule 2d); a comparator cell that is EXCLUDED invalidates only a clearing treatment (rule 2g) and is otherwise recorded as a COMP_UNANCHORED validity note.

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical to the parent's frozen system prompt; raw/harness_config.json file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb, prompts.system string sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876), run IN THIS EXPERIMENT through the same frozen parent runner, artifacts, GBNF grammar and sampling schedule as its treatment cell, as a paired within-packet comparator controlling run-level environment drift. Frozen parent anchor (audit PASS): task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), and zero terminal answer actions across all 10 evaluated episodes. Note: the parent reported no answer_action_emission_rate metric (a new metric defined in this packet as the fraction of episodes emitting >=1 terminal answer action), so the zero-answer fact is established from the parent's raw episode traces (parent result.json#observations) and re-derived in this packet from the same frozen run_episode records, not from a parent metric value.
baselines.expected_outcome: Fail the capability bar (task_success_rate < 0.6) with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6, ideally reproducing the parent anchor (task_success_rate=0.0, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0, zero answer actions). Exact anchor match is recorded as REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; a bar-failing deviation that preserves parseability is recorded as REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT (validity note; contrast remains identifiable). A comparator that CLEARS the bar or drops below parseable 0.6 is a hard invalidation (rule 2d); an EXCLUDED comparator is COMP_UNANCHORED and invalidates only a clearing treatment (rule 2g).

baselines.description: M-3B-QWEN under P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED; same paired-anchor logic as B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B. Frozen parent anchor: task_success_rate=0.0 (0/5), parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (5/5), zero terminal answer actions (parent result.json#observations).
baselines.expected_outcome: Fail the capability bar with parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (target the exact parent anchor; deviations handled as for B-UNDERSPECIFIED-PROMPT-7B).

baselines.description: Uniform random action selection from the frozen 5-action valid space (click #reveal-btn; answer TARGET-41; answer TARGET-42; answer TARGET-43; answer unknown), 5 episodes, seeded RNG random.Random(42) created once and reused across episodes (exactly as the parent's mode_null_random does), run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates. NOTE: the parent measured this control on an un-navigated about:blank page (its null-random mode never navigates to the served port), which structurally forced click_ok=false and task_success=0; the parent's control_episodes.json therefore cannot certify the random baseline's true chance realization. This design repairs that control-sensitivity defect by navigating to the served page before the episodes. Analytic per-episode success probability = sum_{j=1..4} (1/5)^(j+1) = 0.04 + 0.008 + 0.0016 + 0.00032 = 0.04992, so P(task_success_rate >= 3/5) = P(Binomial(5, 0.04992) >= 3) ~ 1.15e-3 and the 0.6 bar is effectively unreachable by chance. Design-time simulation of the parent's exact one-draw-per-step rng.choice stream (non-outcome-bearing, re-derived at EXECUTE) realized task_success_rate = 1/5 = 0.2 and parseable_action_rate_step1 = 5/5.
baselines.expected_outcome: parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction); task_success_rate well below the 0.6 bar (design-time seed-42 realization 0.2). EXECUTE must record task_success_rate < 0.6; if task_success_rate >= 0.6 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. The exact 0.2 is descriptive, not a gate.

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M (grandparent E-LOCAL-LLAMA). NOT re-run. Parent/grandparent evidence: emits prose with no parseable JSON action, 0/5.

Pollinations anonymous proxy (gpt-oss-20b), grandparent E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI. NOT re-run. Parent evidence: empty/reasoning-only content, ~197-token cap, intermittent HTTP 402, no SLA/pinning. Carried as the recorded fallback decision input if the local 3B-8B class yields the bounded negative.

positive_control.success_criterion: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 per evaluated cell; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight

members.protocol: 10 probes per cell (each candidate under BOTH prompt conditions): the frozen probe string from raw/harness_config.json#prompts.positive_control_probe ('Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}') under the cell's own prompts.system with the frozen GBNF grammar (grammar string embedded in raw/harness_config.json#gbnf_grammar, string sha256 16c9877c0829b2099bd7180c212f28d8c545b095e9a4411afa7cabccd3fa6a65, re-verified at EXECUTE after per-cell overlay materialization; file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb).
members.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid JSON matching the action schema (positive_control_pass_rate=1.0)
members.failure_policy: a cell whose PC fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes for that cell); if both candidates' treatment-cell PCs fail -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (decoding infrastructure failure, not model capability).

members.protocol: 5/5 scripted episodes (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42) driven through the REAL run_episode scorer (imported from the frozen parent runner) against the served page, with navigation repaired. Binding producer contract (prereg.md Appendix A.3): the frozen step_producer(obs, step) -> (raw, latency_s, completion_tokens, producer_meta) passes raw (a STRING) to the frozen parse_action which json.loads it, so the scripted producer returns json.dumps({"action":"click","selector":"#reveal-btn"}) on step 0 and json.dumps({"action":"answer","text":"TARGET-42"}) on steps >= 1. This exact string-returning oracle was executed 5/5 at design time through the real run_episode with a real browser (prereg.md Appendix B canary rows; non-outcome-bearing, no model under test).
members.success_criterion: 5/5 task_success=true (proves the scorer registers the full completion path and the mechanical verification is live)
members.failure_policy: <5/5 -> preflight failure -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (scorer broken, not model behavior).

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real scorer against the SERVED task page (navigated)
null_control.failure_policy: any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID

measurement_validity: Only prompts.system varies between treatment and comparator cells; the task, frozen parent-runner code path, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling schedule, seeds, model artifacts and environment are identical. Byte-identified at pre-freeze: P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED is the exact parent system string (sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876); P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716) is the grandparent SYS string (sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with the single ref->selector key alignment. Per-cell configs are materialized by loading the frozen parent harness_config.json and replacing ONLY prompts.system (prereg.md section 4.2), writing the overlay to the exact path the frozen runner reads, <per-cell-outdir>/raw/harness_config.json (load_config(outdir) opens os.path.join(outdir, "raw", "harness_config.json"); verified by reading the runner), so every other config key is inherited byte-for-byte.

Model cells are executed by the FROZEN parent runner research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py (sha256 2b5d5bb5da608adbcc68cc78120a88bc2b8809816e29f9d87d25c0c75bc25c00) invoked per cell with --outdir pointing at a per-cell directory whose raw/harness_config.json is the deterministic overlay. No new model-path or scoring code is authored; the outcome-determining parsing/episode/measurement logic is the parent's.

Deterministic protocol: temperature=0.0, llama_seed=42, episode seeds 42-46, max_tokens=512, n_ctx=2048, chat_format=qwen, n_threads=4. Parent traces were exactly uniform across episodes (audit VF-03); the 3/5 rule is the pre-declared adequacy rule for a capability gate, not a statistical threshold, and no variance estimate is possible from the design.

Controls (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION, B-RANDOM-ACTION) run against the SERVED task page through the same run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect), so a positive result is registerable by the scorer and a null result cannot be an artifact of a broken navigation.

Comparator cells are collected unconditionally for every evaluated candidate BEFORE any outcome decision; the identification contrast is the contemporaneous within-run pair (same run, same model, same everything except prompts.system). The frozen parent anchor (task_success_rate 0/5, parseable_action_rate_step1 5/5, zero answer actions) is an expected drift monitor: exact match -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; bar-failing deviation with parseable >= 0.6 -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT (validity note, contrast remains identifiable). A comparator that clears the bar or drops below parseable 0.6 is hard MEASUREMENT_INVALID (rule 2d); an EXCLUDED comparator is COMP_UNANCHORED and invalidates only a clearing treatment (rule 2g).
Positive control gates each cell: PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING 10/10 before that cell's episodes; PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 at preflight.

Cell completeness and exclusion (spec.decision_rule definitions): a cell is COMPLETE iff its PC-JSON gate passed and it recorded exactly clearing_threshold.episodes=5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff its PC-JSON gate did not pass (no episodes run). A partial cell (PC passed but fewer than 5 episode records) cannot decide a clearance or a confound -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative; a candidate whose treatment cell is EXCLUDED is unresolved, not counted as a capability failure.

Strict mechanical verification: Playwright DOM assertions + JSON-schema parse (identical parsing rule to parent: the whole completion must be valid JSON matching {action: click|answer, selector?: string, text?: string}); no LLM grading. Success additionally requires the mechanical reveal (#target visible with text TARGET-42) and a terminal answer action whose text equals TARGET-42.

GGUF provisioning is fail-closed on digest: downloaded files must match the sha256 receipts pinned from research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37982024058/raw/gguf_sha256.txt (file sha256 93836c2594b0c156c0fa913fb384e913586cb03adbd501773fdf6fd450176dbd, re-verified at EXECUTE; same model, same quantization Q4_K_M); mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not model capability). Download routing receipts are recorded per the parent's raw/provisioning_evidence.json (file sha256 7b1e50436e75292baa88029264938773342b99785536a94c185d8371b74693f0) so the exact provisioning path of this packet is auditable end-to-end.

No prompt tuning, no model substitution, no post-freeze design changes. The treatment prompt leaks neither '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time: substrings absent), so a treatment success cannot be attributed to answer leakage.

The treatment prompt is the ONLY new factor relative to the parent: the parent FALSIFIES ceiling (underspecified prompt) is superseded by the goal/schema protocol ceiling exactly as the Director's bounded-negative exit requires.

Grammar admission vs parse acceptance (self-attacked at design time): the frozen GBNF admits any single-field object whose keys are 'selector' or 'text' independent of the 'click'/'answer' action, so grammar-feasible completions include schema-mismatched objects (e.g. {"action":"answer","selector":...}) that the frozen parse_action rejects (parent runner parse_action). Treatment liveness therefore rests on the empirically verified PC 10/10 and the comparator's 5/5 step-1 parseable behavior, NOT on the claim that every grammar-feasible output is parseable. A treatment cell whose parseable_action_rate_step1 falls below 0.6 fails the bar (it cannot clear), so this residual cannot manufacture a false SUPPORTS.

Second-order attribution limit: the treatment bundles (a) the goal sentence, (b) the action-schema enumeration, and (c) the grandparent's exact phrasing/wording. This design identifies the bundled causal effect of the grandparent goal/schema system prompt vs the underspecified comparator (the Director's operational question); it does not separate goal-only from schema-only, from phrasing, or from a generic longer-prompt effect. That decomposition is explicitly out of scope and is recorded as a limitation, not a confound for the Director's bundled goal/schema question.
decision_rule: OUTCOME in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status=COMPLETE unless operational blockers prevent every cell. DEFINITIONS: a CELL is one (candidate, prompt-condition) unit = PC-JSON gate (10 probes; passed iff positive_control_pass_rate==1.0) + an episode batch (clearing_threshold.episodes=5). A cell is COMPLETE iff its PC gate passed AND it recorded exactly 5 episode records; EXCLUDED iff its PC gate did not pass (no episodes run); PARTIAL iff its PC gate passed but it recorded fewer than 5 episode records; CLEARS iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate>=0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6; a comparator cell is VALID iff COMPLETE and task_success_rate<0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1>=0.6; CONFOUND iff COMPLETE and (task_success_rate>=0.6 OR parseable_action_rate_step1<0.6). Comparator validity is required for ATTRIBUTION of a treatment positive; it is descriptive (anchor replication) for a treatment negative, because FALSIFIES is a statement about the treatment cell alone and the scorer's liveness is guaranteed separately by preflight PC-ORACLE-EPISODE. PRECEDENCE (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE==5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION==(parseable 0.0, success 0.0) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION==(parseable 1.0, task_success_rate<0.6) AND all freeze_artifact hash checks match AND required stack imports OK AND GGUF digest checks PASS; else OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (2) CANDIDATE LOOP over [M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN] in order, each candidate measured in ONE run: (2a) run the TREAT cell (PC-JSON gate then 5 episodes) and run the COMP cell (PC-JSON gate then 5 episodes) unconditionally as a contemporaneous pair; (2b) if the TREAT cell is EXCLUDED, the candidate yields no capability measurement: record it UNMEASURED_TREATMENT_PC_FAILED and continue to the next candidate (unresolved, NOT a failure; its COMP disposition is recorded but does not gate other candidates); (2c) if the TREAT cell is PARTIAL, or COMP is PARTIAL while TREAT is COMPLETE -> a partial cell cannot decide a clearance or a confound -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, STOP; (2d) if the COMP cell is CONFOUND (task_success_rate>=0.6 OR parseable_action_rate_step1<0.6) -> prompt effect not identifiable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, STOP; (2e) record the comparator disposition if COMP is COMPLETE-and-VALID (task_success_rate=0.0 and parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 and zero answer actions -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_EXACT; any other VALID value -> REPLICATION_ANCHOR_DRIFT validity note; COMP EXCLUDED -> COMP_UNANCHORED validity note); (2f) if the TREAT cell CLEARS AND COMP is COMPLETE-and-VALID -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED), STOP (early stop on first attributable clearing candidate); (2g) if the TREAT cell CLEARS but COMP is EXCLUDED (COMP_UNANCHORED) -> a clearing treatment that cannot be contrasted against its contemporaneous anchor is unattributable -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, STOP; (2h) if the TREAT cell is COMPLETE but does not CLEAR, record the candidate as TREATMENT_FAILS_BAR and continue. (3) If at least one TREAT cell is COMPLETE and none CLEARED -> OUTCOME=FALSIFIES (bounded negative over the evaluated COMPLETE treatment-cell set; any COMP_UNANCHORED/DRIFT dispositions are preserved as validity notes and do not block the treatment-level negative). (4) If no candidate produced a COMPLETE TREAT cell (all EXCLUDED or interrupted) -> OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. status=COMPLETE for SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES; status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the invalid branches. A treatment-cell PC failure is never encoded as a capability failure.
product_consequence_positive: If any candidate completes click-then-answer under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA while its contemporaneous comparator cell fails the bar (PROMPT_ATTRIBUTED): the parent FALSIFIES is bounded to the underspecified-prompt ceiling, audit VF-01's prompt-underspecification hypothesis is confirmed as the driver, and C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3) is satisfied at mechanism level (a factory-provisionable credential-free programmatic endpoint can perform a minimal multi-step Web-agent task). The frozen four-arm benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, same model/tools/budget) becomes executable with the verified goal/schema prompt as the in-prompt task specification, subject to the separate dynamic-range certificate for the comparator arms. Whether C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL is a DIRECTOR adjudication, not a DESIGN or EXECUTE conclusion.
product_consequence_negative: If no measurable candidate clears under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (FALSIFIES = the Director's bounded negative at the prompt-ablated ceiling): the step-0-reveal re-click loop is NOT caused by missing instruction context at the 3B-8B Qwen class; the capability ceiling for credential-free CPU-quantized local models under this task/harness is real, readiness condition (3) is not satisfied by this model class, and the four-arm benchmark's credential-free path remains DESIGN_COMPROMISED. The recorded endpoint receipts (E-LOCAL-LLAMA, E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI tokens/SLA) and the re-scope set (drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor in favor of internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank; or provision a hosted endpoint with pinning/SLA; or pursue a different model class) become decision inputs for the Global Research Director; this packet does not pre-decide the re-scope. A MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome changes no claim and requires the recorded repair before any re-run.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4, ~15 GB total RAM; design-time probe: Python 3.12.15, cmake 3.31.6, gcc/g++ 13.3.0, /usr/bin/google-chrome present). Up to 2 candidates x (1 comparator cell + 1 treatment cell) x (10 PC probes + up to 5 episodes x up to 5 steps) llama.cpp inferences; parent measured mean latency 5.065 s/call (7B) and 2.154 s/call (3B) at 13-17 completion tokens/call, so inference is ~10-25 min worst case (early stop after the first clearing treatment cell). Provisioning: re-download ~6.8 GB GGUFs via the confirmed huggingface.co resolve-redirect route (URLs + sha256 pinned; HEAD probes at design time: 3B 200, 7B split shard1 200, shard2 200, 7B single-file 404 as documented) ~20-45 min; llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 sdist build (cmake 3.31.6 + gcc/g++ 13.3 verified present; no cp312 wheel published) ~5-15 min; playwright install (Chrome present at /usr/bin/google-chrome) <5 min; controls/preflight <5 min. No external API spend. Wall-clock estimate 45-150 min.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in BOTH directions: this is the cheapest measurement that separates the two competing explanations audit VF-01/U-01/U-02 left open (prompt underspecification vs model capability/planning deficit) for the exact candidate pair, at the exact frozen protocol, with within-run paired comparators and fail-closed preflight. SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark; FALSIFIES (bounded negative) closes the credential-free local 3B-8B path as a capability result (not a prompt artifact) and hands the Director the recorded receipts for the hosted-endpoint re-scope. This is readiness-condition-(3) work explicitly allocated by the Director's CONTINUE mandate and is NOT a census rerun or an economics claim (P2-REPLAY-COST guard applies only downstream: matched tasks and fully loaded counterfactual costs before any replay/economics claim).

candidates.note: Frozen single-file URL (qwen2.5-7b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf) returns HTTP 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation, raw/provisioning_evidence.json); the same-repo same-quant split shards are the pinned artifacts, digest-verified at download and loaded by passing shard1 as model_path (llama-cpp-python auto-locates the companion shard).
Single-file Q4_K_M; resolve URL verified live (HTTP 200 HEAD) at design time.

P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.
P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED.provenance: Byte-identical to the frozen system prompt of the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (raw/harness_config.json#prompts.system; file sha256 7aba9dc899c40dd29f87b4265835eea6dc0b889c66271a983e4b82b8f5bc7adb, string sha256 1294954da7b1d6b9570b07e1e39cb48515b925355d0f33d5fabf72c8e8ce3876). This is the comparator condition; its parent cell outcome (0/5) is the frozen expected anchor, re-measured contemporaneously in this packet.

P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.verbatim: You are a web agent. Reply ONLY with one JSON object per turn, no prose. Actions available: {"action":"click","selector":"<id>"} or {"action":"answer","text":"<code>"}. Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.
P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA.provenance: Derived from the grandparent harness SYS constant in research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-37973264582/raw/code/min_webagent.py (file sha256 4e2b6710c78f4e4399a8ed5ae78e0231563fb832b780b80a955bcbc16b046862; SYS string sha256 742e5aae5b5ffd72ccb43cb18658a14483660e7659640df651e91011e9b6dc12) with a single ref->selector schema alignment (adapted treatment string sha256 36a4240aba96e46797c16aebbedcc548778a0c1097b4ce4432608148758c5716). Justification: the parent task's frozen GBNF admits only the keys 'selector' and 'text'; the grandparent prompt's 'ref' key is not in the grammar. The alignment makes the prompt's named schema match the grammar-enforced schema so the treatment measures the goal+schema content rather than a prompt/grammar key mismatch. Adds exactly the two dimensions audit VF-01 says the parent prompt lacked: (a) enumeration of the action schema and (b) the task goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.' Does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42' (verified at design time).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome is arithmetically reachable and no branch is empty or shadowed. SUPPORTS requires a COMPLETE treatment cell >= 3/5 task_success with a COMPLETE-and-VALID contemporaneous comparator, which the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary (5/5 through the real scorer, deterministic scripted actions) proves the scorer can register and which the parent realized at the comparator end (0/5); the treatment-cell outcome is empirically open (the whole point of the ablation). FALSIFIES is reachable whenever at least one COMPLETE treatment cell fails to reach 3/5; the parent realized exactly this behavior and neither candidate is guaranteed to clear, so this branch is reachable. MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via preflight failure (rule 1), a partial cell (rule 2c), a comparator confound (rule 2d), an unattributable clearing treatment (rule 2g), or no measurable treatment cell (rule 4). The threshold 0.6 over 5 episodes (k in 0..5, k>=3) is fully attainable for both outcomes. Precedence 1..4 has no unreachable later rule: rule 2 executes only if rule 1 did not fire; rule 3 fires exactly when at least one treatment cell is COMPLETE and none cleared; rule 4 covers the residual no-measurable-treatment case. Early stop at 2f cannot shadow comparator validity because the comparator cell is collected unconditionally before any decision (2a). Each cell is a 5-element deterministic vector, and the parent already realized both extremes (0/5 task success and 5/5 step-1 parseable). The support path is not grammar-blocked (strchar ::= [^"\\] admits '-', digits and uppercase, so "text":"TARGET-42" is grammar-admissible) and the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary registered the full click-then-answer completion 5/5 through the real scorer at design time (prereg.md Appendix B), so SUPPORTS is reachable and MEASUREMENT_INVALID branches are reachable via the enumerated preflight/partial/confound/unattributable conditions.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is verified at DESIGN time or pinned to a frozen, previously-satisfied contract with fail-closed verification. (a) Stack assemblable in this factory (design-time probe): Python 3.12.15, pip 26.2.1, cmake 3.31.6 + gcc/g++ 13.3.0 present (llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 has a PyPI sdist and no cp312 wheel, so the sdist build path is required and feasible); Chrome present via /usr/bin/google-chrome; CPU-only nproc=4, ~15 GB total RAM (parent loaded the 7B split shards under these constraints). llama-cpp-python and playwright are NOT preinstalled, so EXECUTE installs/builds them. (b) GBNF grammar well-formed: all 7 rules (root, ws, action, field, string, strchars, strchar) are defined and referenced (checked statically at design time); the grammar was constructible and executed by the parent; success-path feasibility re-verified (strchar ::= [^"\\] admits '-', digits, uppercase, so "text":"TARGET-42" and "selector":"#reveal-btn" are grammar-admissible - the click-then-answer success path is NOT grammar-blocked, so FALSIFIES cannot be a grammar artifact). (c) Model URLs verified live at design time via the confirmed resolve-redirect route: 3B 200, 7B shard1 200, shard2 200, 7B single-file 404 (parent-documented packaging deviation), with sha256 pinned from raw/gguf_sha256.txt (digest mismatch -> provisioning_failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID). (d) Harness and fixture are bound repo files (freeze_artifacts) whose parsing/episode/verification logic was executed end-to-end by the audited parent; model cells invoke that frozen runner directly and the controls/evaluator import its scoring primitives. (e) The serving page and Playwright flow were proven by the parent (task_episodes.json). (f) Scorer/controls liveness executed at DESIGN time as a non-outcome-bearing canary through the REAL frozen run_episode scorer and a REAL browser (Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome) against the served page, using the Appendix A.3 producer contracts with a name-only llama_cpp import stub (no model inference): PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 task_success, NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION parseable 0.0/success 0.0, B-RANDOM-ACTION (repaired navigation) parseable 1.0/task_success 0.2. This certifies every mechanical prerequisite except the llama.cpp model path itself, which the audited parent already proved end-to-end (PC 10/10, 5/5 parseable step-1 under constrained decoding). The only EXECUTE-time creations - GGUF re-download, per-cell configs materialized by the deterministic overlay in prereg section 4.2, and the thin controls/evaluator driver bound by prereg Appendix A - are fully determined by frozen identifiers/digests and prereg text.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparator differ ONLY in prompts.system (P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA vs P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED, byte-diffed at design time), and both are run through the SAME frozen parent runner with the SAME task page, GBNF grammar, user template, sampling schedule, seeds, model artifacts and code path, so any difference in task_success_rate / parseable_action_rate_step1 / answer_action_emission_rate between paired cells is attributable to the prompt, or to detectably-broken infrastructure caught by the fail-closed preflight and comparator-validity checks. The measurement range is non-degenerate: the same scorer registers 5/5 at the top (PC-ORACLE-EPISODE) and the parent produced 0/5 task success at the bottom under the comparator prompt, with the comparator sitting mid-range on parseability (5/5). The random baseline is confined strictly below the bar (analytic P(task_success_rate >= 3/5) ~ 1.15e-3). Cost observables (latency, tokens) are descriptive per cell and identical in kind for both arms. The comparator cells are re-measured contemporaneously in this packet (not inherited-only), with exactly 5 episodes per evaluated cell.

control_sensitivity.reason: All controls run against the SERVED task page through the SAME run_episode scorer as the candidates (navigation repaired relative to the parent's about:blank control defect, which structurally zeroed the parent's random baseline). Control sensitivity was EXECUTED at design time as a non-outcome-bearing canary through the real frozen run_episode with a real browser (Playwright + /usr/bin/google-chrome; name-only llama_cpp import stub; no model under test, prereg Appendix B): PC-ORACLE-EPISODE fired 5/5 task_success (each 2 steps, revealed TARGET-42, terminal answer TARGET-42, target visible) proving the positive control fires and the completion path is registerable; NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION stayed 0/5 parseable and 0/5 success (verification rejects non-JSON); B-RANDOM-ACTION was parseable 1.0 (valid JSON by construction) and task_success_rate=0.2 (< 0.6) with the 0.6 bar effectively unreachable by chance (analytic P(>=3/5) ~ 1.15e-3), so the control cannot accidentally clear it; PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING fired 10/10 for both models in the audited parent under the identical grammar and probe (re-verified per cell at EXECUTE). No control is tautological (none contains the target answer supplied to the model) or structurally impossible (all have non-empty, attainable expected outcomes distinct from the treatment outcome space). Distinct controls cover decoding, scoring, null rejection, and chance-level task success.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment arm is structurally live: P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA enumerates exactly the two matched actions admitted by the frozen action schema ('click' with 'selector', 'answer' with 'text') using the grammar's required key names, and the audited parent's PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING and comparator episodes show this model class reliably emits parseable matched actions under constrained decoding (10/10 PC; 5/5 step-1 parseable), so the treatment can reach both the click and the answer branch. Self-attack (recorded, not hidden): the frozen GBNF does NOT by itself guarantee matched action/field pairs - it also admits schema-mismatched objects (e.g. answer+selector) that the frozen parse_action rejects - so liveness rests on the verified empirical decoding behavior plus the rule that a below-0.6 step-1 parseable rate can never clear the bar, not on a syntactic claim. The success path (click then answer) is both grammar-admissible ("text":"TARGET-42" and "selector":"#reveal-btn" via strchar ::= [^"\\]) and registerable by the same scorer: the PC-ORACLE-EPISODE canary fired 5/5 through the real run_episode scorer with a real browser at design time, including the exact Appendix A.3 string-returning producer contract (prereg Appendix B; non-outcome-bearing). Provisioning feasibility of the exact model artifacts is verified by parent receipts and design-time URL liveness probes. The comparator cell is equally live (byte-identical to the parent prompt that produced 5/5 parseable step-1 actions with the same models). Model weights are digest-pinned and the download route is proven. The treatment does NOT leak '#reveal-btn' or 'TARGET-42', so a positive is not an artifact of answer leakage.

The per-cell configs need no local file existence at freeze time: each is a deterministic transformation of the frozen parent harness_config.json (listed above) - load it and replace ONLY prompts.system with the condition system string frozen verbatim in spec.prompt_conditions and prereg.md section 4.2 - so every other key (positive_control probe string/count, null_control content, random_baseline 5-action space, task.page_html, gbnf_grammar, sampling, clearing_threshold) is inherited byte-for-byte from the bound parent file and no outcome-relevant key is unbound. The thin EXECUTE controls/evaluator driver is bound by prereg.md Appendix A; prereg.md itself is a freeze input hashed into freeze.json. The controls driver and evaluator do NOT exist at freeze time and are therefore not listed as freeze_artifacts file entries; their behavior is fully determined by the frozen prereg Appendix A text, and the evaluator is a pure deterministic function of raw evidence records plus the frozen thresholds (no model calls, no free parameters, no outcome inspection), so no unbound mutable dependency can change the interpretation. EXECUTE records the materialized driver/config sha256 in provenance.json and any deviation from Appendix A in result.json validity_notes. Remote content (GGUFs) cannot be frozen as bytes; their URLs and sha256 digests are frozen in spec.json/prereg.md per the transmission contract, with parent receipts proving the route. No other mutable local dependencies exist.
